rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a landlord who leases out a flat, shop, or other property.

example.english: I’ve already paid the rent to the landlord.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gaau1 zo2 zou1 bei2 jip6 zyu2

rows.note: Use this for a landowner or traditional landlord associated with land or an estate, rather than the usual landlord of a rented flat.

example.english: The landlord used to own this whole tract of land.
example.traditional: 以前成幅地都係個地主嘅。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 seng4 fuk1 dei6 dou1 hai6 go3 dei6 zyu2 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the owner or manager of a pub or bar.

example.english: The landlord of that bar knows all the nearby customers.
example.traditional: 嗰個酒吧老闆識晒附近啲客。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 zau2 baa1 lou5 baan2 sik1 saai3 fu6 gan6 di1 haak3
